ctx.fillRect(x1, baseY - hLora, bw, hLora); ctx.fillStyle = "#c4512c"; ctx.fillRect(x2, baseY - hFull, bw, hFull); ctx.fillStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.font = "13px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("LoRA", x1 + 32, baseY + 20); var sq = 40 + d / 2048 * 80; var rw = 8 + r / 64 * 60; ctx.fillStyle = "#d9e3f5"; ctx.fillRect(ax, ay, sq, sq); ctx.fillStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.fillRect(ax + sq + 12, ay, rw, sq); ctx.fillRect(ax + sq + 12 + rw + 12, ay, sq, rw); ctx.fillStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.font = "14px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("saves " + ratio + "x", x1, baseY + 44); for (i = 0; i < 5; i++) { var gy = baseY - maxH + i * 30; ctx.strokeStyle = "#8a8175"; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
